audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Skill at Level 1 and Level 6 Skill, contradicting the page's own whys (Ornn has 'near-zero early damage'; his R 'shuts off your run-at-them pattern entirely').
audit.why: Ornn has no level-1 sustain and Bellows Breath costs him health, so Singed wins Level 1 outright; Call of the Forge God's knockup plus Brittle is a hard Ornn window at 6. Level 3 is genuinely even per whys[2].
audit.corrected: Level chart flipped as a group: L1 Singed, L3 Skill, L6 Ornn. Rest unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike/cooldown text was generic — 'track it before every engage' with no numbers.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, Call of the Forge God 140/120/100s. Concrete numbers make the commit windows actionable.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries the real rank-1 numbers and what each one enables.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Mega Adhesive grounds Searing Charge, and Volcanic Rupture's pillar is terrain that Ornn's own E collides with to knock you up.
audit.why: Ornn's E is a charge (dash-class) and grounding denies it — that is why glue under his feet ends both his engage and his escape. Ornn's Q 'a magma pillar forms', E 'if Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave... knocks up' — so his own Q makes the wall he needs. 'Stay away from walls' was incomplete advice.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2] and dontsFull[1] now state grounding-vs-charge and pillar-as-terrain instead of mismatched template text.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] title 'Kite his weak early' was paired with a description about wasting Volcanic Rupture; dontsFull[1] 'Get brittle-procced' was paired with 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown' — both template mismatches.
audit.why: Title and description described different things, so neither read as advice.

edits.before: You lose most level-1 duels — set up the proxy game instead. Identify how Ornn contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Ornn has no sustain at 1 and Bellows Breath costs him health — walk Poison Trail straight through him before Searing Charge exists to answer it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ornn must walk into your range.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds his Searing Charge, but a Brittle-procced knockup answers your root — even skirmish territory.

edits.before: Ult-ghost-proxy is a macro weapon — you win by farming where he is not. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God knocks up and re-applies Brittle, cancelling your run pattern — a clean R combo outpaces Insanity Potion's regen.

edits.before: You lose most level-1 duels — set up the proxy game instead. Respect Ornn's Volcanic Rupture completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Ornn is one of the weakest level-1 laners — no sustain, and Bellows Breath costs him health. Run poison through him, and stay off walls: his Q pillar is terrain his own E knocks you up against.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Keep moving. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Volcanic Rupture: 9s at rank 1 — the pillar it leaves is terrain his E knocks you up against. - Searing Charge: 14s, his only gap-close; commit while it is down. - Call of the Forge God: 140s at rank 1.

edits.before: Ornn wastes Volcanic Rupture — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mega Adhesive grounds it — he cannot charge in or back out of your cloud.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: That pillar is terrain — his Searing Charge into it is a free knockup.

edits.before: Proxy + kite — his early is weak, dodge his Q. Singed wins the Volcanic Rupture cooldown windows.
edits.after: Proxy + kite — his early is weak. Glue his Searing Charge (14s) and never fight beside his Q pillar.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your proxy window — Ornn has no chase tools and no way to punish you farming behind his wave near his tower. Keep an eye on his E cooldown: Searing Charge is his only gap-close, and if you see it on cooldown you can commit to a Fling and run him through your cloud before he can disengage. At level 6 respect his power spike: Call of the Forge God's double knockup cancels your kite pattern clean, and Brittle means a full combo can two-shot your health bar before Insanity Potion's regen kicks in. Play around his R cooldown — if he burns it to roam or secure dragon, that is your window to all-in him with Insanity Potion active and Fling him away from a wall so he cannot pillar-pin you in return.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your proxy window — Ornn has no chase tools and no way to punish you farming behind his wave near his tower. Searing Charge is his only gap-close on a 14s cooldown at rank 1; the moment you see it spent, Fling him and run him through your cloud, because Mega Adhesive grounds that charge and he cannot escape the way he came. At level 6 respect his power spike: Call of the Forge God knocks up and re-applies Brittle, cancelling your kite pattern clean, and a full combo can two-shot your health bar before Insanity Potion's regen kicks in. It is 140s at rank 1 — if he burns it to roam or secure dragon, that is your window to all-in with Insanity Potion up, fought away from his Q pillar so he cannot charge into it and knock you up.

notes: packet suspectNames for ornn are all false positives — Poison Trail and Insanity Potion are the correct Riot names.
